faq_heading: Homes near Surrey Traditional: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Surrey Traditional catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Surrey Traditional home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Surrey Traditional, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Surrey Traditional?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are James Ardiel Elementary (0.2 km south-west), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.1 km south) and Ellendale Elementary (1.5 km east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Surrey Traditional

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Surrey Traditional in a straight line (15 elementary, 3 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is James Ardiel Elementary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cape Horn Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is K B Woodward Elementary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: James Ardiel Elementary (0.2 km south-west), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.1 km south), Ellendale Elementary (1.5 km east), Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.6 km south), Iqra School (1.6 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is James Ardiel Elementary, 0.2 km south-west of Surrey Traditional.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Surrey Traditional

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Surrey Traditional can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Surrey Traditional are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at James Ardiel Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.2 km south-west of Surrey Traditional. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
